item.title: Mod manager for Escape from Duckov
item.description: A mod manager for Escape from Duckov. Manage local, Steam Workshop and NuGet mods, switch mod suites in one click, and launch the game.

item.title: Enable the NuGet Market
item.description: Turn on NuGet Gallery in SuperDucky's mod market to browse and install mods published on NuGet, and learn the risks first.

item.title: Enable the Save Gallery
item.description: Install SuperDucky.Connector and enable the save gallery to see the items collected in your save, search and filter them, and compare their attributes.

item.title: Mod Management
item.description: Manage local, Steam Workshop and NuGet mods in SuperDucky with mod suites, groups, ordering, filters, history restore and health checks.

item.title: Installation
item.description: Download and install SuperDucky on Windows, macOS and Linux, and verify the download.

item.title: Screenshots
item.description: Screenshots of SuperDucky by area - setup wizard, home, mod management, mod market, log viewer and settings.
